verses.text: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

segments.text: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.

segments.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.

segments.text: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.

segments.text: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

segments.text: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.text: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.

segments.text: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.

segments.text: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.

segments.text: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”

segments.text: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”

verses.text: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

segments.text: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

verses.text: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.

segments.text: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
